claim: In the HWA laboratory, the `resource MDMDA#RES01;1;noask` command did not create a missing resource; it returned AWSBHU072E because no matching resource object existed. The NEEDS execution test therefore requires creating the persistent resource definition through the model/DWC/Composer resource-definition workflow before running the stream.
